tei:div.tei:p: "!#༄༅// chu sgyur gyi man ngag zab pa 'ga' zhig bzhugs so//

ྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈ rtsa ba gsum la phyag 'tshal lo: shwa 'od zlog pa'i man ngag ni: gro ga dag la gla rtsi yis: nya gzug kha mig tshang ba bri: de yi mtha' la sngags 'dis bskor: āom̐ badzra la baṃ dzambha na ye: āom̐ badzra la laṃ st+wambha na ye: āom̐ badzra la st+wambha ya: bhandha bhandha: a di skyin thang shwa 'od zlog: chu sgyur swā hā: zhes bris nas ni spra tshil lam: la chas dril te glang dmar gyi: rwa cor bcug la re bas gril: chu yi gnod pa yod sar sba: de steng tho gsum brtsigs nas su: rigs gsum mgon por mnga' gsol la: rab gnas byed cing bkra shis gsol: de yi mdun du rdo 'khor 'di: chu log yong sar kha bstan bzhag: shwa 'od ji ltar che na yang: the tshom med par bzlog par 'gyur: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: zab : gu ru rin po che chos kyi dbang phyug gi gter ma'o// rdo 'khor bri thabs ni/ rdo 'jam po la chos 'byung bzhi bsnol ma bris pa'i zur rnams su/ āom̐ badzra ga ru ḍa haṃ sa he tsa le tsa le swā hā: zhes cha bgos la bri/ lte bar drag sngags yi dam gang byed kyi snying po'i mthar/ yul 'dir shwa kha dang sbud kha thams cad srungs shig rakṣa rakṣa: zhes dug khrag gis bri/ 'di chu sna 'dren pa'i 'khor lo ste phar phyogs su bzhag /nya 'khor dang tho lcog bcas kha phyir bstan la 'bab chu'i 'gros su 'dzug /rdo 'khor la chos sman dang bzang drug byug /spra tshil gyis mnan la chus mi 'jig pa'i thabs bya'o// 'dzug pa'i dus thebs legs par brtsis la sngags pa rang gi yi dam gyi gzhung bsrang*/ bsang dang gser skyems dam tshig bsgrags pa sngon du 'gro bas rab gnas mnga' gsol bya'o/ ༈ /ha ya ghrī wa na mo/ gdams pa 'di tshul bzhin du nyams su blang na rgya gar gyi chu bo gaṅgā yang zlog nus pa rdo rje dbyug pa'i man ngag go /de ltar skar ma rgyal gyi nyin par lam ltag tu skyes pa'i shing gla ba'i lcug ma mi khyis ma 'gongs pa khru gang ba bcad la dbyug pa bya/

de'i nang du āom̐ badzra kro dha hya ghrī wa hu lu hu lu hūm̐ phaṭa/ hu ra hu ra/ ku ra ku ra/ ha na ha na/ hūm̐ hūm̐/ phaṭa phaṭa/ āom̐ āḥhūm̐ hrīḥdu sa ma ya bhyo zlog /yul sa phyogs lung pa'i bye brag 'di zhes bya bar skyin thang shwa 'od chu dgra'i gnod pa thams cad rakṣa rakṣa/ zlog zlog sgyur sgyur/ ces bris pa'i shog dril bcug /dbyug pa'i phyi la'ang ci mang bri/ phyi nang gnyis ka la thal chen dang dug khrag byug /bzlas yungs dang skyes bu dam pa'i gdung thal gyi thum po gdags/ chu rags kyi gseb tu chu mi 'chor bar sbas la rta mgrin du bskyed bstim rab gnas bya'o// glo bur du chu shor na dbyug pas gdengs shing sngags bzlas pas bzlog go /yang 'phral du gdong zlog byed na/ sran ma dkar po 'bru bdun la/ ṇi ni ra sa ni mā ra ya bhyo zlog /ces bzlas la btab/ lh+wam nang du bcug cing brdab pas 'phral du bzlog par 'gyur ro/ ༈ /yang chu zlog shin tu zab pa lugs gcig la/ chu zlog 'khor lo ni/ nya gzugs skye mched dod pa chur rgyug tu bris pa'i lto bar/ yul 'di la/ lung pa 'di dang*/ phyogs 'di nas 'ong ba'i skyin thang shwa 'od chu dgra chu 'dre dang bcas pa thams cad phyir zlog cig /sgyur cig ces bri/ mgo nas brtsam ste mthar g.yas skor du/ oṃ dza la mo he ha ri ni ye dza dza/ la mo dha ra ni a a ni lam ni lam dza la dza la st+wambha ni ya/ bhandha bhandha skyin thang zlog /shwa zlog chu sgyur swā hā/ zhes bri/ dug khrag gis byug /mjug nas dril la la cha'i nya gzugs kyi khog par bcug /de glang dmar 'og can gyi rwa'i sbugs su mi 'chor bar bcug la mgo chu dgra 'ong phyogs su gtod la bzhag go 7 /shes rab chu 'dren gyi 'khor lo ni/ rdo nag la dug khrag gis mu khyud zlum po gling bzhi'i ling tshe can bri/ ling tshe rnams su gong gi sngags dang*/ spel tshig /skyin thang shwa 'od chu dgra chu 'dre dang bcas pa'i sna dmigs pa'i yul lung pa sa phyogs 'di zhes bya ba la drongs shig

/sgyur cig ces dang*/ mtha' skor la'ang de ltar bris la phar phyogs su 'dzug 7 /sna 'dren gyi 'khor lo ni/ rdzas la dbang phyug gi gzugs byas la mdun du sngags 'di rim pa gsum du bri'o// oṃ e kyang sa ra du na zlog /nang du/ he kyang du na zlog /ces dug khrag gis bris pa'i shog dril dang*/ lung pa'i phu nas btus pa'i chu srad dkar po dang*/ bar nas btus pa'i sro lo dkar po gnyis bsregs thal/ mda' nas blangs pa'i chu rdo'i 'og gi sa spyin mkhregs po gsum gyis bkang*/ thun rdzas dang la chas kha bcad la chu yong ba'i phyogs su kha bstan pa glang ru'i mdun du bzhag go /'di rnams so so'i sngags stong phrag gsum re tsam bzlas pas bsgrub/ rab gnas rgyas par bya'o// shwa 'od ji ltar che yang thub nges pa'i dmar byang ngo*/ ༈ /shwa zlog re mig byang gter lugs 'di rdo nag la ba bla'am ldong ros kyis bris la chus byug /rten 'brel snying po brgya rtsas rab gnas bya/ chu yong ba'i phyogs su kha bstan nas bzhag pas 'gyur nges so// ༈ na mo gu ru/ chu sgyur 'di ni g.yam pa gtsang ma la ba bla dang la cha bsres la bri/ g.yam pa'i sgrom chus mi khyer ba'i nang du shwa 'od 'ong sar kha bstan la sbas te bzhag /rgya nag rten 'brel gyi re'u mig ces dge ba'i bshes gnyen shwa pho sgang pas shwa 'od brgya tham pa bzlogs pas mtshan la'ang dpal shwa pho sgang pa zhes nyi zla ltar grags so// maṅga laṃ// ༈ dbang phyug gi sgo nas 'dre 'od zlog pa ni/ skyer pa/ se ba/ bud med kyi dor rta rnams bsregs thal dang*/ kham sa tshi can bsres la dbang phyug gi gzugs bya/ de'i khog sngags 'di dbu can du bris la bcug /oṃ ru na ru na tri hri bhyo ma ra dun ti bhyo skye zer la bhyo rbad zer la bhyo/ dbang phyug la gtor ma gtang*/ rang gi rags gseb tu sba zhing mis mi mthong bar bya'o// 'di'i sngags 'dra min/

oṃ ru na dun ti hril bhyo/ phra ma dun ti hrīl bhyo/ skya ther la bhyo/ rbad ther la bhyo// zhes snang ngo*/ ༈ /yang mdze thod la sngags 'di nyi shu rtsa gcig bri/ thal chen/ ri bong ril ma/ nyungs dkar rnams bcug la shwa sna bud sna'i mtshams su sba'o// sngags ni/ ta kra dza ta kra nu hu ya ru lu ru lu hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces bri bzlas bya'o// thabs 'di rnams re res kyang thub la/ gal te shwa 'od tshabs che na bca' gzhi phal cher tshang bar bgyis pas phan par the tshom med do// sarba dā maṅga laṃ bha ba tu/// /
